editorial.blurb: Family-owned gem serving authentically homemade Mexican and American fare with meticulous attention to flavor and detail.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive ready to dig into chips and salsa while you order — service is prompt, and the owners are genuinely engaged with each table, so ask Carlos or Luis about the daily specials.

topDishes.note: Perfectly crunchy, described as the best ever had
Juicy, succulent, flavorful meat with complementary salsas
